implement_load_from_fileobj: implement a subclass of BaseFileHandler that overrides load_from_fileobj to parse data from a file object
implement_dump_to_fileobj: implement a subclass of BaseFileHandler that overrides dump_to_fileobj to serialize an object to a file object
implement_dump_to_str: implement a subclass of BaseFileHandler that overrides dump_to_str to serialize an object to a string
use_load_from_path: use the load_from_path method of a BaseFileHandler subclass to load data from a file path
use_dump_to_path: use the dump_to_path method of a BaseFileHandler subclass to write an object to a file path
